study: qal/mspeed -- SPEED CEILING of the three-phase DRIVEN-mesh wave (qal/mesh3 lineage, commit 5b9d05b): cell upsizing s x T_third x depth d on VACASK (PRIMARY engine), Xyce as the cross-check on anchor rows. Energy REPORTED, never gated. Ideal driven mesh = BOUND.
written_before_any_design_deck: This file is written BEFORE the committed design-point deck (qal/mesh3/runs/trap_tt92_d3/c_trap_tt92_d3.cir) is run on either engine under this study and BEFORE mspeed.py exists. The only simulator activity so far: (i) a one-inverter PWL-rail VACASK SYNTAX smoke (not the design; checked raw-file names 'ph1','o1_1_0','vph1:flow(br)'); (ii) a PyMS VAE-cache cold-JIT warm-up of the same one-inverter deck on Xyce under the study's own cache (vae_cache_mspeed). Neither produced a scored number.
user_direction: speed of the logic for packet processing / DSP, not power efficiency; VACASK over Xyce (faster), cross-check both ways on some rows.

instrument.vacask_model: /usr/local/lib/vacask/mod/psp103v4.osdi (md5 20a700d5ced64225bac3c15e5cbbc36d, built 2026-10-01 from /usr/local/src/VACASK/devices/psp103v4/psp103.va = CMC PSP 103.4.0 / JUNCAP 200.5.0 August 2016). Xyce side: /usr/local/share/xyce/verilog-a/psp103/psp103.va = the SAME 103.4.0 source; diff reviewed before this file: the Xyce tree adds Xyce attribute blocks, units strings, aliasparam M=MULT, an `_XYCE_HACK` temperature-init block and the induced-gate-noise NOIR/NOIC network (transient-irrelevant) -- NO device-equation change. Model card: p620a/vacask_port/sg13g2_models.inc REUSED VERBATIM (generated by gen_models_sg13g2.py from the same kestrel tt .lib the Xyce decks include; level dropped, type added, the 10 Xyce-ignored params dropped). NOTE the local OSDI md5 differs from the P620a certification artifacts (different host/build); the certification below re-establishes the offset ON THIS HOST before anything is quoted.
instrument.vacask_settings_pre_stated: options tran_method="gear" reltol=1e-5 (default abstol 1e-12 / chgtol 1e-15 / vntol 1e-6 -- the certified p620a port setting; Xyce-tight abstol/chgtol collapse the VACASK stepper, OFFSET_TABLE lesson). analysis tran step=0.1p stop=7T maxstep=0.25p icmode="op" (NEVER uic: the uic +20% silent-wrong lesson). No forced ic is needed: every node is DC-connected to a PWL source at t=0 (phase A 0 V, B and C 1.65 V, head words), exactly the OP Xyce solves. Series R_s = 0.001 ohm stays a real sp_resistor (VACASK minr default 0 -> no clamp). The cap-integrator/B-source metering networks are OMITTED on VACASK (no behavioural B source) and replaced by the validated OFFLINE trapezoid meter applied identically to the Xyce .prn and the VACASK .raw (p620a offline_meter.py convention: energies quotable via the offline path only).
instrument.tolerance_ladder_pre_stated: On the design point, VACASK reltol 1e-4 -> 1e-5 -> 1e-6: between 1e-5 and 1e-6 every commit_raw instant must move < 0.3 ps and every margin_at_commit < 0.2%; otherwise the sweep runs at 1e-6.
instrument.xyce: /usr/local/src/xyce-build/src/Xyce, PYMS_DIR=/usr/local/share/xyce/PyMS, PYMS_VAE_CACHE=<scratchpad>/mspeed/vae_cache_mspeed (own cache). Deck = mesh3.deck() lines byte-identical for the design point (checked against the committed c_trap_tt92_d3.cir before running).
instrument.extractor: mesh3.extract() gated logic reused LINE-FOR-LINE (Trip_S interpolation, M2a largest-run pick, E1 edge interpolation on the 0.10 ps grid, M4/M4c commit_raw from the bank's own powered window, M4b/M4d value at the raw-validity midpoint, handoff overlap, 69.924 mV gate); the only port is the grid loader (VACASK raw names -> the V(PH)/V(O)/I(VPH)/I(VMG) column names) and the two mt0-sourced diagnostics (crest FINDs, third-boundary integrator reads) which become grid/offline reads at the SAME nominal instants on both engines (no +1 ps FIND lag on either side -- offline like-for-like, SKEPTIC Amendment 3).
instrument.box: shared; <= 3 simulator processes from this study at any time; load average 13 at writing (other agents' Xyce runs) -> wall times are LOADED-BOX numbers, reported as a ratio on back-to-back runs.

certification_task1.design_point: trap, T_third=92, d=3, P0, R_s=0.001, s=1 (committed row: eye 129.0 ps, worst margin 509.67 mV, worst overlap 37.021 ps, 144/144 value, SUSTAINS).
certification_task1.comparison_method: BOTH engines re-metered OFFLINE from their own waveform files on the same 0.10 ps grid with the same code; no .measure-to-.measure comparison (Xyce FIND-AT samples ~0.9 ps early on moving signals).

acceptance_bands_PRE_STATED.rail_waveforms: max_t |V_vacask(ph_k) - V_xyce(ph_k)| <= 5 mV for every k (ramp 17.9 mV/ps; a 0.25 ps knot-straddle = 4.5 mV), RMS <= 0.5 mV.
acceptance_bands_PRE_STATED.establishment_instants: commit_raw(link k, wave n), 18 values: |delta| <= 1.0 ps each.
acceptance_bands_PRE_STATED.commit_margins: margin_at_commit (HIGH and LOW, links 1..5, waves 2..4): |delta| <= max(1% of the Xyce value, 5 mV).
acceptance_bands_PRE_STATED.standing_eye: asymptotic width and every per-link 0 mV width: |delta| <= 1.0 ps.
acceptance_bands_PRE_STATED.value: identical pass/fail set (144/144 checked, 0 fails on both); restored_HIGH_min within 5 mV.
acceptance_bands_PRE_STATED.charge_energy_books: per bank per third (Q_rise/Q_hold/Q_fall, E_*), offline trapz both sides: |delta| <= 2%. Xyce in-engine integrator (mt0 reads) vs Xyce offline on the same instants: <= 1% (reported; the +1 ps FIND lag x I(t) explains up to ~0.6%).
acceptance_bands_PRE_STATED.wall_time: reported both ways on the same deck, same box, back-to-back; no band (user expects VACASK faster).

certification_task1.violation_rule: Any band miss -> STOP and diagnose in this order: (1) VACASK stepper (maxstep/reltol ladder, break=all on the PWL), (2) OP vs uic / t=0 state, (3) grid-loader column mapping, (4) model card / OSDI version. Nothing from the sweep is quoted on an uncertified instrument; if a residual is irreducible, the frontier cells run on BOTH engines and the Xyce value is the quoted one.
certification_task1.cmos_comparator_certification: Load-matched CMOS chain level: qal/fcrit_skept sk_chain.cir arm D rebuilt on VACASK (depth 12, same cell, 2 fF per node, 1.2 V, 2 ps input edge; per_stage_90 = (t90(d8) - t90(d4))/4 with t90 = 0.9*VDD rising crossing on the even nodes) must reproduce 52.510 ps within 1%. The same deck at scale s in {2,4} (w scaled, 2 fF per node) gives the LOAD-MATCHED comparator for each s, and at VDD = 1.65 V the ISO-VOLTAGE comparator (same cell, same load, the mesh crest voltage). Xyce re-run of the s=1 1.2 V chain as the cross-engine row (band 1%).

sweep_task2.grid: s in {1,2,4} (wp=1.12u*s, wn=0.74u*s, l=0.13u; CL = 2 fF external per output, next-level gate load scales with s -- physical), T_third in {92,80,70,60,50,40} ps, d in {2,3,4}; 6 banks, trapezoid, P0; one dense transient per cell (step 0.1p maxstep 0.25p, 0.10 ps extraction grid, tend = 7T, waves 2..4 scored). Full grid, no early stop (committed M3). P1 (the killing mixed word) on every frontier cell; a frontier cell requires P0 AND P1 to PASS.
sweep_task2.acceptance_carried: A value (last-level word at the raw-validity midpoint, all banks, waves 2..4) AND B eye (min-gate margin at the handoff commit sample >= 69.924 mV, links 1..5) AND C handoff (overlap > 0, links 1..5). Energy never gates.
sweep_task2.frontier_definition: fastest T_third per (s,d) with P0 and P1 PASS. If the pass set is non-monotone in T_third (a faster cell passes while a slower one fails) BOTH are reported and the frontier is the fastest member of the CONTIGUOUS passing run from 92 downward.
sweep_task2.metrics_per_cell: value-correct waves (3 scored), worst commit margin vs 69.924 mV, worst handoff overlap, standing eye (asymptotic 0 mV width), per-link establishment (commit_raw - srx, and commit_raw - s_k relative to the bank's own rise), erosion sign, per-bank per-cycle Q and E from the rail (offline trapz, mean over waves 2..4, REPORTED), rising-side tracking lag.
sweep_task2.ratios: wavefront level-rate = (d/T_third)/(1/367.888 ps); per-lane results/s = 1/(3*T_third); per-level traversal = T_third/d (wavefront-defined) AND the TRUE per-level latency = (commit_raw(link 5, wave n) - n*T)/(5d) (head edge to the real bank-6 receiver's commit; link 6's receiver is DERIVED and is reported separately).
sweep_task2.droop_sensitivity: at the fastest passing (s,d,T_third) cell: R_s = 10 and 100 ohm (mesh3 convention), acceptance re-check + crest droop over the hold third + surviving links.
sweep_task2.xyce_cross_check: the fastest passing cell and one failing neighbour (next-faster T_third, same s,d) on Xyce, same deck: agreement bands as in certification; PASS/FAIL verdict must agree.

PREDICTIONS_task3.physics_model_DERIVED_from_mesh3: Chain recurrence: a bank's d levels take E_d ~ r*T_third + d*t_lv from its own rise start (r*T_third = ramp wait, t_lv = per-level time at the 1.65 V crest, mesh3-calibrated ~27-30 ps at s=1 from the +25..30 ps/level chain law and the committed d=2/3/4 commit instants); the wave SUSTAINS when the receiver's establishment is hidden under the predecessor's hold+fall lifetime. Measured s=1 facts carried: d=2 passes at 70 (floor not reached), d=3 floor 80 (70 fails on establishment), d=4 fails at 92..117 and only just misses at 130 (margin 50 mV).
PREDICTIONS_task3.upsizing_hypothesis: Cell delay ~ (s*C_int + C_L)/(s*g) = (C_int + 2 fF/s)/g with C_int (gate + junction of the next identical cell) ASSUMED ~5 fF at s=1: t_lv shrinks by f(2)=0.86, f(4)=0.79 (diminishing returns: the fixed 2 fF is a MINORITY of the load at s=1). The ramp-wait term is s-invariant, so the T_third floor moves LESS than t_lv: floor(s)/floor(1) ~ 0.90 (s=2), 0.85 (s=4).
PREDICTIONS_task3.expected_best_cell: s=4, d=2 at 40 ps (or s=4, d=3 at 60 if d=3 goes one step further than predicted): wavefront level-rate 0.050/ps = 18.4x CMOS (range 15-21x); per-lane 8.3 G results/s (1/(3*40 ps)).
PREDICTIONS_task3.upsizing_verdict_rule: UPSIZING HELPS = the on-grid floor drops by >= one grid step for at least one d between s=1 and s=4 AND the per-link establishment (commit_raw - s_k) shrinks monotonically with s at fixed (T_third,d). Predicted: TRUE in sign, BOUNDED in size (one grid step at d=2 and d=3; floor(s=4)/floor(s=1) ~ 0.8-0.9). If the floors do not move at all, the rail ramp (an s-invariant fraction of T_third) dominates and the hypothesis is FALSIFIED for this cell family.
PREDICTIONS_task3.energy_reported: per bank per cycle net E ~ scales ~s at fixed T_third,d (gate+junction charge scales; CL fixed): ~176 fJ (s=1, 92/3 committed) -> ~300 (s=2) -> ~550 fJ (s=4); E rises further at smaller T_third only through the (tiny) resistive term. REPORTED ONLY.
PREDICTIONS_task3.droop_prediction: at the fastest s=4 cell: R_s=10 ohm still PASSES (mesh3: 10 ohm cost 12 mV of margin at s=1; ~4x current at s=4 -> ~50 mV); R_s=100 ohm FAILS (mesh3: 100 ohm at 80/3 already failed; s=4 draws ~4x).

latency.comparators: (i) CAMPAIGN comparator: load-matched CMOS chain level 52.51 ps at 1.2 V, 2 fF (fcrit_skept) -- NOT 57.14 single gate, NOT 94.17 at 6.91 fF. For s>1 the load-matched comparator is the s-scaled chain at 1.2 V (to be measured; expected 52.51*f(s)). (ii) ISO-VOLTAGE comparator: the same chains at 1.65 V (the mesh crest); expected ~28-33 ps at s=1 (ASSUMED from the chain law), *f(s) for s>1.
latency.prediction: wavefront per-level time T_third/d at the frontier ~ 20-27 ps; TRUE per-level latency (head -> link-5 commit)/(5d) ~ T_third/d + 1..3 ps. Versus (i): 0.45-0.6x -> the mesh BEATS the campaign comparator by ~2x: a LATENCY WIN on the campaign's own comparator, i.e. the standing 'latency never wins' rule (tank physics, 105 ps/level) is STALE for the driven mesh. Versus (ii): parity within +/-15% (predicted ratio 0.85-1.15): the win over (i) is a SUPPLY-VOLTAGE win (1.65 V vs 1.2 V on the same cell), not an architectural one.
latency.verdict_rule: 'Latency win' is declared against (i) if true per-level latency < 52.51*f(s) at the matched s. An ARCHITECTURAL latency win is declared only if true per-level latency < 0.85x the iso-voltage load-matched chain level (ii) at the same s. Both numbers are reported MEASURED; the verdict sentence states which comparator it is against.

PREDICTIONS_task3.engine_wall_time: VACASK faster than Xyce on the design point by 2-5x (p620a tg15p: 31 s vs 139 s = 4.5x; that deck was smaller). Reported as a measured ratio; both single-threaded on the loaded box.

labels: Every number in RESULTS.json / README.md is tagged MEASURED / DERIVED / ASSUMED; the ideal driven mesh is a BOUND; model language: tracking lag / eye / margin at the sampling instant, never 'settling'.
